translations.web: whose harvest the hungry eats up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.
translations.bsb: The hungry consume his harvest, taking it even from the thorns, and the thirsty pant after his wealth.
translations.kjv: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
translations.asv: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, And taketh it even out of the thorns; And the snare gapeth for their substance.
